segments.name: Healthcare IT
segments.description: Provides technology-enabled revenue cycle management, cloud software and digital health solutions to healthcare providers, hospitals and health systems.
segments.evidence: The Company views its operations as comprising two operating segments, Healthcare IT and Medical Practice Management.

segments.name: Medical Practice Management
segments.description: Provides medical practice management services, including facilities, equipment, supplies, nurses and administrative support staff, to medical practices.
segments.evidence: The Company has determined that its business consists of two operating segments and two reporting units (Healthcare IT and Medical Practice Management).

revenueModel.text: Healthcare providers pay the company for technology-enabled revenue cycle management, cloud-based software and medical practice management services.
revenueModel.evidence: We provide technology-enabled revenue cycle management and a full suite of proprietary cloud-based solutions to healthcare providers, from small practices to enterprise medical groups, hospitals, and health systems throughout the United States and certain other locations.
